latest_release.name: Translate It! v1.25.2
latest_release.body:
Released on 29 October 2026
--- ##### Changed - Improved compatibility with various websites for smoother, more reliable floating translation controls and a more consistent browsing experience.
--- ### 🧩 Install Now Click your preferred browser to install:
---

What's Changed

 * docs: update demo video links in README files by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/387 * fix(content): prevent UI positioning issues on pages with root containment by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/388 * fix(content): harden promoted UI host against page CSS by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/389 * fix(content): detect additional root CSS containing blocks by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/390 * fix(content): isolate Select Element highlight styles by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/391 * fix(content): support dynamic root CSS changes for UI positioning by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/392 * chore(release): prepare v1.25.2 by @Amm1rr in https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/pull/393
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/compare/v1.25.1...v1.25.2
